messages.subject: inla.contrib.sd function not found
parts:
Hi,
I have tried to use the inla.contrib.sd  to rescale my posteriors to the scale of the standard deviation.
However, it gave me an error message and said the function cannot be found.
I have switched to the testing version of INLA before I ran this.
Is there an alternative function that essentially work in a similar way?

Many thanks

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] inla.contrib.sd function not found
parts:
No, you have to convert those results manually. 


> r=inla(y~1,data=data.frame(y=1:10))
> m.sd = inla.tmarginal(function(x) exp(-x/2), r$internal.marginals.hyperpar[[1]])

--
